items.title: The expensive mistake is assuming it is harmless

cards.text: ✕ “It’s probably just a heat shield.” Heat shields buzz at specific RPMs. They do not change with engine load or persist on cold starts. Persistent rattling is almost always internal.
cards.fullText: ✕ “It’s probably just a heat shield.” Heat shields buzz at specific RPMs. They do not change with engine load or persist on cold starts. Persistent rattling is almost always internal.

cards.text: ✕ “I’ll drive it until it gets worse.” Driving with timing chain wear can cause the chain to snap. Pistons then hit valves, taking the repair from £700 to £10,000+ overnight.
cards.fullText: ✕ “I’ll drive it until it gets worse.” Driving with timing chain wear can cause the chain to snap. Pistons then hit valves, taking the repair from £700 to £10,000+ overnight.

cards.text: ✕ “Any garage can fix this for a few hundred.” Timing chain replacement is engine-out work on many cars. Labour alone can exceed £500 on V6/V8 engines.
cards.fullText: ✕ “Any garage can fix this for a few hundred.” Timing chain replacement is engine-out work on many cars. Labour alone can exceed £500 on V6/V8 engines.

cards.text: ✕ “I can just replace the tensioner.” Worn guides or chain stretch require full replacement. Tensioner-only fixes rarely work.
cards.fullText: ✕ “I can just replace the tensioner.” Worn guides or chain stretch require full replacement. Tensioner-only fixes rarely work.

items.title: Most serious rattles start small, then escalate
items.description: In most UK cases, engine rattling is caused by timing chain wear, particularly in high-mileage diesel engines. The BMW N47 and VAG EA189 are among the most commonly affected.

blocks.question: How much does engine rattling diagnosis cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: £50-£150 at UK independent garages. This includes a physical inspection and listening test.

blocks.question: What causes rattling on cold start only?
blocks.answer: Timing chain tensioner bleed-down or initial guide wear. The noise disappears as oil pressure builds. Replacement is recommended.

blocks.question: Can I drive with an engine rattling noise?
blocks.answer: If it is momentary on cold start only, short journeys may be possible. If it persists, worsens, or comes with warning lights, do not drive.

blocks.question: Is rattling always timing chain failure?
blocks.answer: No. Heat shields, accessory belt tensioners, and exhaust leaks can also cause rattling. But persistent rattle that changes with engine speed is usually timing-related.

blocks.question: How much does timing chain replacement cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: £700-£1,500 for 4-cylinder engines; £1,200-£2,700 for V6/V8 engines. Labour costs vary by vehicle.
